3.name: Clockwork Spells
3.notes:
You always have the following spells prepared at the listed Sorcerer levels:

3rd: Aid, Alarm, Lesser Restoration, Protection from Evil and Good
5th: Dispel Magic, Protection from Energy
7th: Freedom of Movement, Summon Construct
9th: Greater Restoration, Wall of Force

Additionally, your spellcasting manifests visually or audibly. Choose or roll (1d6) on the Manifestations of Order table:
1. Spectral cogwheels hover behind you.
2. Clock hands spin in your eyes.
3. Your skin glows with a brassy sheen.
4. Floating equations and geometric shapes appear around you.
5. Your focus transforms into a Tiny clockwork device.
6. Ticking gears or clock chimes are heard by you and affected creatures.

3.name: Restore Balance
3.notes:
When a creature you can see within 60 feet would roll a d20 with Advantage or Disadvantage, you can use your Reaction to negate both, forcing a normal roll.

Uses: Charisma modifier (minimum 1). All uses restored after a Long Rest.

6.name: Bastion of Law
6.notes:
As a Magic action, expend 1–5 Sorcery Points to create a ward around a creature you can see within 30 feet. The ward contains a number of d8s equal to the Sorcery Points spent.

When the warded creature takes damage, it can expend any number of those dice, roll them, and reduce the damage by the total.

The ward lasts until you finish a Long Rest or create a new ward using this feature.

14.name: Trance of Order
14.notes:
As a Bonus Action, enter a precise mental state for 1 minute. While active:
- Attack rolls against you cannot gain Advantage.
- Whenever you make a D20 Test, treat rolls of 9 or lower as a 10.

Once used, this feature cannot be used again until a Long Rest, unless you spend 5 Sorcery Points to restore it (no action required).

18.name: Clockwork Cavalcade
18.notes:
As a Magic action, summon intangible clockwork spirits in a 30-foot Cube originating from you. They immediately produce all of the following effects, then vanish:

Heal. Restore up to 100 Hit Points divided among creatures of your choice in the Cube.

Repair. Instantly repair damaged objects entirely within the Cube.

Dispel. End every spell of level 6 or lower on creatures and objects of your choice in the Cube.

Once used, you can't use this feature again until a Long Rest unless you spend 7 Sorcery Points to restore it (no action required).
